content.comment_body: I'm interested to know if the [product_name] CIM will soon replace the [product_name] CMR. I haven't seen it listed in any official [company_name] catalog or on the Selection Tool, though manuals and other documentation are already accessible on SIOS. Thanks! [user_name]
You should reach out to [company_name] directly. The best way is to submit a support request.

For more information, refer to the delivery release of [product_name] CIM ([article_no]) and also to [article_no] - MODBUS Communications Module [product_name], [company_name] as well as MODBUS Communications Module [product_name].
Currently, [product_name] CMR [version_no] modules are still available. I'm not aware of any official plans to discontinue or replace them.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are requesting clarification on whether the new [product_name] CIM module is intended to replace the existing [product_name] CMR modules. Confusion arises because information about [product_name] CIM appears in manuals, but it has not yet been listed in official catalogs or selection tools. The latest available response from [company_name] support indicates that [product_name] CMR modules remain available, and there is no confirmed plan for imminent replacement. This situation reflects users' desire for more transparent updates on product lifecycle and availability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect up-to-date and clear information about product lifecycle from [company_name], with details consistently available across all resources such as manuals, catalogs, and online selection tools.
